title: Match stored help keywords case-insensitively when verifying a sync
message:
Match stored help keywords case-insensitively when verifying a sync

Catalog keywords are normalized to upper case, but most stored
help_keywords rows keep their authored case (2510 on dev, 1709 on
production). The representative lookup compared them with BINARY, so it
failed whenever a sampled entry, such as mastermind, was stored in mixed
case, and every sync stopped after the catalog grew enough to sample one.
The game's own lookup is case-insensitive; the check now is too.

title: Make an invocation of the help-sync skill run the full sync
message:
Make an invocation of the help-sync skill run the full sync

The skill treated a bare invocation as a read-only audit and plan, then
asked before publishing, and let whether production runs the documented
code hold help back. Invoking it now means one complete
sync --authorize-production run to verified publication on both
endpoints, with no confirmation, and nothing about production's deployed
code may delay publication. Only engine-refused conflicts, deletions,
renames, and failed invariants stop the run.
